messages:
Amanda (Product): Heads up — ACME is hitting 502s tied to the dedupe step after the v2 tokenization change. Triggers when payloads exceed ~32k tokens. Sales flagged this as a renewal blocker, asking for a patch ASAP.

Raj (Support): Repro + logs from ACME: ```2026-03-19T18:12:45Z ERROR pipeline.dedupe: Unhandled overflow at kv_cache.cpp:214 stack=... 502 response to client``` They see ~5% error rate on large-batch workloads.

Diego (Eng Oncall): Quick triage: looks like an unchecked KV cache index when tokens exceed page size. I can reproduce locally with a 40k token fixture. Minimal fix: bounds check + early chunking fallback. Low surface area but needs backport to 2.x runtime.

Marcus (Release): Options: 1) Hotpatch to prod (backport -> canary -> promote) 2) Wait for regular minor release in ~2 weeks. Hotpatch requires emergency changelog, QA window, and approval from Release + Eng + CS. ETA for hotpatch: 1-2d dev, 4-6h QA, 30m deploy.

Elena (Sales): Customer is on Dedicated (eu-west-1 reserved pool). They paused integration tests and will delay renewal until resolved. They're asking for a timeline this afternoon.

Nora (CS): I can own customer comms and the rollback/runbook. Requirements for canary: 10% traffic slice for 1h, monitor 5xx rate, p95 latency, and token throughput. If metrics stable -> promote. If degraded -> rollback to previous runtime.

Diego (Eng Oncall): Action plan: I’ll open a PR against release/2.x with the bounds check + unit tests + e2e fixture. Will mark as hotfix. Will also add a feature-flagged canary path so we can traffic-slice Dedicated clusters.

Amanda (Product): Decision proposal: proceed with hotpatch and canary tonight. Marcus schedule canary at 22:00 UTC; Diego starts the PR now. Nora/Elena prepare customer comms with clear ETA and rollback clauses. Signoff to promote -> Marcus (Release) + Diego (Eng) + Nora (CS).

deploy-bot: deploy requested by Diego for release/2.x-hotfix -> canary to dedicated-acme-eu-west1 at 1769854600

Marcus (Release): Canary started 22:10 UTC (10% traffic). First 40m look: 5xx rate down to baseline, p95 latency stable. No regressions seen in traces. Promoting to 100% at 23:00 UTC unless issues pop.

Nora (CS): Sent interim update to ACME with timeline and rollback commitments. They re-ran tests and reported fewer failures so far. I'll update if they see anything else.

Diego (Eng Oncall): PR merged to release/2.x, hotfix deployed to prod canary, monitoring dashboards added (dedupe-5xx, p95-latency, kv-cache-errors). Will keep watch for 2h then hand to oncall rotation.

Amanda (Product): :thumbsup: Hotfix applied and promoted. Closing as emergency fix; next steps: write short postmortem + add a regression test to the v2 CI matrix so large-token fixtures run in nightly. I'll create a follow-up task in the roadmap board.

Marcus (Release): Noted — I'll file the release note and mark the change as hotpatch (2.1.1).

Raj (Support): Marking ticket as resolved from our side pending final ACME confirmation.

Nora (CS): ACME confirmed green on re-run. Closing customer incident.

Amanda (Product): Thanks team — good cross-org response. We'll debrief in tomorrow product sync for process improvements.
